title: dipsacus sylvestris subsp. ferox
intro: Dipsacus sylvestris subsp. ferox, commonly known as European Teasel, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the family Dipsacaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits, such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Dipsacus sylvestris subsp. ferox include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
